name: Process Pulse
author: meviusisback
description: Process manager for the Omarchy bar: processes grouped by application with live CPU and RAM, automatic detection of processes in trouble (busy loops pinned to a core, blocked tasks, zombies, runaway spawn trees) and a one-press TERM/KILL for a whole group. Safe by design: every PID is re-validated against a snapshot (command, start time, owner) before any signal, other users' processes are refused, and a TERM that is ignored escalates to SIGKILL after a grace period.

barWidget.description: Grouped processes, runaway detection and one-press kill.

schema.label: Refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often the panel re-reads the processes while it is open. CPU figures need two samples, so they become accurate after one interval. Busy-loop detection fires after about runawaySamples intervals.

schema.label: Runaway detection (samples)
schema.description: Consecutive samples a process must stay above ~95% of a core before it is flagged as a probable busy loop. At the default refresh (2 s) that is about 10 seconds.

schema.label: Sort
schema.description: Order of the group list: severity (problems first), cpu, mem or name.

schema.label: Show totals in panel
schema.description: Show process count, total CPU and RAM in the panel header.
